cards.def:
The state of physical and mental well-being.
हिंदी: स्वास्थ्य

The health of the population as a whole.
हिंदी: जन स्वास्थ्य

Medical services for maintaining health.
हिंदी: स्वास्थ्य सेवा

Healthcare for all without financial hardship.
हिंदी: सार्वभौमिक स्वास्थ्य कवरेज
examples: Universal Health Coverage must be achieved.
Universal Health Coverage protects the poor.
Universal Health Coverage is a global goal.

cards.def:
Protection against disease through vaccination.
हिंदी: टीकाकरण

Poor health from inadequate diet.
हिंदी: कुपोषण

A state of cognitive exhaustion resulting from prolonged periods of demanding mental activity.
हिंदी: मानसिक थकान
examples: Air traffic controllers take mandatory breaks to prevent debilitating mental fatigue.
Mental fatigue impairs executive decision-making and slows reaction times considerably.
Adequate sleep and screen-free intervals are essential to recover from mental fatigue.
Students facing marathon exam schedules often struggle with acute mental fatigue.

cards.def:
A physical illness or symptom caused or aggravated by psychological factors like chronic stress.
हिंदी: मनोदैहिक विकार
examples: Severe work pressure manifested physically as a debilitating psychosomatic disorder.
Doctors investigated whether the patient's recurrent stomach pain had psychosomatic origins.
Treating a psychosomatic disorder requires addressing mental stressors alongside bodily symptoms.
Chronic anxiety can trigger a psychosomatic disorder involving persistent muscle tension.

cards.def:
A constant, long-term state of profound physical and mental depletion that rest does not relieve.
हिंदी: लगातार बनी रहने वाली थकावट
examples: Caregivers of elderly relatives frequently experience chronic exhaustion.
Medical practitioners screened the patient to rule out underlying causes of chronic exhaustion.
Chronic exhaustion severely impacts productivity, mood, and immune system resilience.
Corporate culture that glorifies overwork inevitably drives employees into chronic exhaustion.

cards.def:
Disease caused by daily habits.
हिंदी: जीवनशैली से जुड़े रोग

A disease of high blood sugar.
हिंदी: मधुमेह

Practices for maintaining health and cleanliness.
हिंदी: साफ़-सफ़ाई

Safe water for drinking and use.
हिंदी: स्वच्छ पेयजल
examples: Clean Water is a basic right.

cards.def:
Health of women during pregnancy and childbirth.
हिंदी: मातृ स्वास्थ्य

Deaths of children under five.
हिंदी: बाल मृत्यु दर

Average lifespan of a population.
हिंदी: जीवन प्रत्याशा

A physical or mental condition limiting activity.
हिंदी: दिव्यांगता / विकलांगता

The quality of being easy to reach or use.
हिंदी: सुगम्यता

Support for older people.
हिंदी: वृद्धजन देखभाल

Care for serious illness relieving suffering.
हिंदी: उपशामक देखभाल / कष्ट-निवारक देखभाल

Fair access to health for all.
हिंदी: स्वास्थ्य समानता
examples: Health Equity is a moral goal.

cards.def:
Financial protection for medical costs.
हिंदी: स्वास्थ्य बीमा

Direct payments for healthcare.
हिंदी: जेब से किया गया ख़र्च

A medical professional treating illness.
हिंदी: डॉक्टर / चिकित्सक

A health professional caring for patients.
हिंदी: नर्स / परिचारिका
examples: Nurses are the backbone of care.

cards.def:
Essential worker during emergencies.
हिंदी: अग्रिम पंक्ति का कर्मचारी

Moral principles in healthcare.
हिंदी: चिकित्सा नैतिकता

Agreement after knowing risks.
हिंदी: सूचित सहमति

When microbes resist medicines.
हिंदी: दवा-प्रतिरोध

Public knowledge about health.
हिंदी: स्वास्थ्य जागरूकता

Healthcare to prevent illness.
हिंदी: निवारक देखभाल

Testing for early disease detection.
हिंदी: जाँच / स्क्रीनिंग

Facilities and systems for healthcare.
हिंदी: स्वास्थ्य ढाँचा

The practice of medicine and public health supported by mobile communication devices.
हिंदी: मोबाइल स्वास्थ्य सेवा
examples: Mobile health applications allow rural clinics to transmit diagnostic data to city hospitals.
Patients in remote villages received diabetic monitoring alerts via mobile health platforms.
Mobile health revolutionized prenatal care tracking across developing regions.
Government health ministries rolled out mobile health hotlines for immunization reminders.

cards.def:
Healing practices based on tradition.
हिंदी: पारंपरिक चिकित्सा

An approach to healthcare and life that emphasizes the interconnected wellbeing of body, mind, and spirit.
हिंदी: समग्र स्वास्थ्य
examples: The clinic promotes holistic wellness by integrating balanced nutrition, exercise, and therapy.
Holistic wellness shifts the medical focus from treating illness to sustaining lifelong vitality.
Workplace initiatives that cultivate holistic wellness report lower absenteeism rates.
Mind-body practices like yoga and meditation form the bedrock of holistic wellness.

cards.def:
A compulsive physiological or psychological need for a habit-forming drug or substance.
हिंदी: नशे पर निर्भरता
examples: Rehabilitation centers provide comprehensive medical detox for substance dependency.
Substance dependency can destroy personal finances, careers, and family relationships.
Community support programs offer nonjudgmental pathways to recover from substance dependency.
Early therapeutic intervention is vital in breaking the grip of substance dependency.

cards.def:
Harmful use of drugs or alcohol.
हिंदी: नशीले पदार्थों का दुरुपयोग

Measures to reduce tobacco use.
हिंदी: तंबाकू नियंत्रण

Unfair differences in health outcomes.
हिंदी: स्वास्थ्य असमानता

Medical measures taken for disease prevention and early health maintenance rather than treatment.
हिंदी: निवारक स्वास्थ्य सेवा
examples: Annual medical checkups and regular immunizations are essential pillars of preventive healthcare.
Investing in preventive healthcare significantly reduces long-term hospitalization expenditures.
Public education regarding balanced nutrition is a high-yield form of preventive healthcare.
Preventive healthcare catches chronic ailments like hypertension before complications develop.
